Independent CXIX heading 79744, synopsis 79746–79753 and actual own papal self-protocol 79755–79756: 'Innocentio  Papa' at 79752 is synopsis attribution and is not the protocol. Ordered petition/reasons 79758–79916 expressly introduce the incorporated congregational decree 79918–80138, whose own ending prints 'Romae, xvni  seplembris  mdcxlviii'; it stays inside the outer confirming act. Papal §4 confirmation 80140–80166 and concluding §§5–7 are complete through 80224. Own historical note 79792–79797 and variants 79799,79852–79853,79855,79857,79941 remain included. Full dating 80226–80228 and short dating 80230 close it before CXX heading 80239/protocol 80249–80250. Exclude only trailing running headers 80233–80236. Full dating prints 'die  ii  ianuarii' and 'MDCXLix'; date remains null without normalization.
